title: Testing family-of-origin sensitization: Parent-adolescent conflict, emotional reactivity, and adolescent internalizing psychopathology.
figures: Conceptual model of family-of-origin sensitization and mental health problems.

Structural equation modeling of the association between global parent-adolescent conflict, emotional reactivity, and depressive symptoms and anxiety symptoms. Paths were standardized coefficients. The model controlled for outcomes at baseline. * p  < .05, ** p  < .01, *** p  < .001.
